rms — ONED signal op

• 資料種類:signal → measurement

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rms(x, frame=None, hop=None)(要直接呼叫實作,import dsp; dsp.rms(x, frame=None, hop=None);從台帳取用則 ops1d.get("rms"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

RMS level. Scalar for the whole signal, or a framewise array when *frame*

is given (a vibration/energy envelope over time).
